meta.name: Pluto TV Pixel World
meta.description:
Pluto TV Pixel World brings you giant blocks of all things Minecraft! Explore some of the wildest mods ever built and tag along with top gamers like Thinknoodles and PrestonPlayz. Don’t miss the excitement on Pluto TV Pixel World!

Shows: I Found Mlg Sunglasses In Rl Craft!! [Minecraft Modpack], So I Adopted Unspeakable in Minecraft / I Found a Doctor Only Server in Minecraft!, Insanely Secure Haunted Minecraft Maze, I Survived the Worlds Coldest Room / 100 Ice Mystery Buttons But Only One Lets You Escape, How to Tame a Pet Emerald in Minecraft
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
